title: Enhancing Autoregressive Video Generation via Representation Adversarial Distillation
title_zh: 通过表示对抗蒸馏增强自回归视频生成

paragraphs.en: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian , a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 0.7805 to 0.8041 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features. Project page: https://rslinfy.github.io/Radian-Project-Page .
paragraphs.zh: 少步自回归视频生成能够实现高效的流式合成，但早期时间块中引入的错误会被重复用作上下文，并可能传播到后续生成步骤，从而导致细节退化、结构漂移和运动不稳定。 现有的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）方法主要对齐扩散潜在空间中学生模型与教师模型的分布，但对解码后视频的感知质量缺乏直接监督。 我们提出了 Radian——一种表示空间对抗性蒸馏框架，它通过基于冻结视觉基础模型（VFM）所定义的特征空间中的真实数据对抗性监督，对在线策略 DMD 进行补充。 在训练过程中，Radian 会从自回归学生模型的生成结果中稀疏解码帧，提取多层级视觉表示，并应用轻量级判别器头来区分生成输出与真实视频帧。 DMD 目标将学生模型锚定到预训练的教师模型，而表示空间对抗性目标则提供补充的感知和语义梯度，从而促进高质量模式的生成。 这些额外组件在训练结束后会被丢弃，因此生成器架构和推理时的去噪预算保持不变。 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上的实验涵盖了四步分块生成、单步逐帧生成以及一分钟长的自回归生成。 我们的方法在四步生成中实现了 VBench Total 0.8444 0.8444 和 VideoAlign Total 0.8033 0.8033，并通过 Rolling Forcing 将 VBench-Long 从 0.7805 0.7805 提升至 0.8041 0.8041，同时减少了去噪步数。 对图像、视频和扩散表示的受控比较进一步表明，不同表示空间的选择会产生独特的对抗信号，且外部 VFM 梯度比源自扩散模型内部特征的对抗性监督能更有效地补充 DMD。 项目页面：https://rslinfy.github.io/Radian-Project-Page .

paragraphs.en: Recent video generation models have substantially advanced visual fidelity, motion realism, and prompt alignment ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Wiedemer et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Seedance & et al., 2026 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ) . However, typical video generators synthesize fixed-length clips through bidirectional temporal attention, incurring prohibitive latency, computational costs and incompatibility with causal streaming generation. These limitations conflict with today’s urgent demand for interactive world models, real-time audio-visual avatars, 3D telepresence, and online video editing, which require continuous generation and immediate response ( Zhao et al., 2026c ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . The central challenge is to retain the quality of a bidirectional teacher under a small sampling budget and long autoregressive rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频生成模型在视觉保真度、动作真实性和提示对齐方面取得了显著进步（Wan 等，2025；Wiedemer 等，2025；Kong 等，2025；Seedance 等，2026；HaCohen 等，2026）。 然而，典型的视频生成器通过双向时间注意力机制合成固定长度的片段，这会导致极高的延迟和计算成本，并且与因果流式生成不兼容。 这些局限性与当前对交互式世界模型、实时音视频虚拟形象、3D远程临场感和在线视频编辑的迫切需求相冲突，因为这些应用需要持续生成和即时响应（Zhao 等，2026c；Sun 等，2025；Huang 等，2025b；Zhu 等，2026b；Lin 等，2026）。 核心挑战在于如何在有限的采样预算和长自回归生成过程中，保持双向教师模型的质量。

paragraphs.en: Most previous works address the first challenge through few-step diffusion distillation. Progressive and consistency-based methods compress iterative denoising by direct mappings between noise levels ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Lu & Song, 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026c ) , while Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a student to reproduce the output distribution of a pretrained diffusion teacher ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Recent video generation methods like Self Forcing further combine distillation with block-wise causal generation and KV caching, and train the student on its own generated histories to reduce the train-test gap ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, early generated blocks with errors become the context for subsequent blocks, and these errors then propagate and accumulate over generation, leading to visual degradation, detail loss, and semantic drift. Moreover, methods like DMD transfer the teacher distribution through score differences in the diffusion latent space, failing to align decoded outputs with real videos.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数先前的研究通过少步扩散蒸馏来解决第一个挑战。 渐进式和基于一致性的方法通过噪声水平之间的直接映射来压缩迭代去噪过程（Salimans & Ho, 2022；Song et al., 2023；Luo et al., 2023；Lu & Song, 2025；Zheng et al., 2026c），而分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）则训练一个学生模型来复现预训练扩散教师模型的输出分布（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a）。 近期的视频生成方法，如自我强制法，进一步将蒸馏与分块因果生成和 KV 缓存相结合，并通过让学生模型基于自身生成的历史进行训练来缩小训练与测试之间的差距（Yin et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2025a；Zhu et al., 2026a；Gu et al., 2026；Ge et al., 2026b；Liu et al., 2026；Cui et al., 2026）。 然而，早期生成的错误分块会成为后续分块的上下文，这些错误随后会在生成过程中传播和累积，导致视觉质量下降、细节丢失和语义漂移。 此外，像 DMD 这样的方法通过扩散潜在空间中的得分差异来传递教师模型的分布，但未能使解码后的输出与真实视频对齐。

paragraphs.en: Another line of works improve few-step generators through adversarial distillation ( Sauer et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . When real samples are used as the positive reference, the discriminator provides a measure of data realism that teacher-based score matching does not offer. ADD exploits this principle for image generation in the representation-space of a frozen DINOv2 encoder ( Sauer et al., 2024b ) . When it comes to video generation, in contrast, discrimination is performed in clean or noise-corrupted VAE latents or internal features from DiT backbones. However, such discrimination may be sub-optimal for improving the video quality, as VAE latents are optimized for compression and reconstruction, whereas diffusion-backbone features are learned for denoising or velocity prediction. The diffusion space used by DMD is close to them, causing adversarial gradients to overlap with score distillation. Moreover, without RGB decoding, the discriminator cannot detect texture blur, artifacts, or VAE decoding errors, making such features suboptimal for adversarial supervision.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present Radian , a method that performs adversarial distillation in representation space to enhance few-step autoregressive video generation. Radian augments on-policy DMD with an adversarial objective over features from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, selected outputs from causal autoregressive rollouts are decoded into RGB frames and mapped to multi-level VFM features, which are distinguished from those of real videos using lightweight discriminator heads. The VFM and discriminator heads are removed after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference cost unchanged. DMD anchors the student to the teacher distribution, while representation-space adversarial supervision uses real data to suppress perceptually and semantically degraded outputs and reshape the learned distribution toward higher-quality modes.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 Radian，一种在表示空间中执行对抗性蒸馏的方法，以增强少步自回归视频生成。 Radian 通过在一个冻结的视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征上引入对抗性目标，来增强在线策略 DMD。 在训练期间，从因果自回归展开中选择的输出会被解码为 RGB 帧，并映射到多层 VFM 特征；随后使用轻量级判别器头将这些特征与真实视频的特征区分开来。 训练结束后，VFM 和判别器头会被移除，从而保持生成器架构和推理成本不变。 DMD 将学生模型锚定在教师模型的分布上，而表示空间中的对抗性监督则利用真实数据抑制感知和语义上退化的输出，并将学习到的分布重塑为更高质量的模式。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are as follows. We introduce a new representation adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data supervision over decoded outputs while preserving the original inference architecture and cost. Beyond the proposed framework, we systematically study adversarial representation spaces spanning image VFMs including DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and SigLIP2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , video encoders including V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) and VideoMAE ( Tong et al., 2022 ) , as well as diffusion-internal features. Our analysis further shows that different image representations induce distinct adversarial signals, video representations provide complementary temporal regularization, and external VFM gradients are more complementary to DMD than diffusion-internal supervision as conceptually illustrated in Fig. 1 . Finally, experiments on causal generators built upon Wan2.1 1.3B demonstrate consistent improvements in visual quality, motion quality, and prompt alignment over strong Forcing-series baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance on VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) and VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) across 4-step, 1-step, and long-horizon generation.

paragraphs.en: Few-Step and Autoregressive Video Generation. Few-step diffusion distillation generally follows trajectory- or distribution-based paradigms. Trajectory-based methods compress teacher sampling trajectories through progressive or consistency objectives ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Lu & Song, 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026c ; Zheng et al., 2026b ) , whereas distribution-based methods directly align student and teacher output distributions. DMD estimates a reverse Kullback–Leibler (KL) gradient from teacher and student score functions, and DMD2 further improves score estimation and training stability ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Ge et al., 2025 ) . Related variants further adapt distribution matching to efficient few-step video generation ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026b ) . For streaming generation, autoregressive video models factorize videos into causal temporal blocks and reuse previous outputs through KV caching. CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) distills bidirectional video diffusion into a few-step causal generator, while Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) reduces the training–inference gap by training on the student’s own rollouts. Causal Forcing and Causal Forcing++ further improve initialization and scalable few-step frame-wise generation ( Zhu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026d ) , while Rolling Forcing and Self Forcing++ extend self-rollout training to long-horizon generation ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . Recent works further explore complementary mechanisms for long-horizon streaming generation: Salt++ aligns causal contexts across generator sampling and score estimation for few-step multimodal generation ( Ge et al., 2026a ) , while Spatia maintains an updatable 3D memory to improve long-term spatial consistency ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 少步与自回归视频生成。 少步扩散蒸馏通常遵循轨迹或分布导向的范式。 轨迹导向的方法通过渐进式或一致性目标压缩教师采样轨迹（Salimans & Ho, 2022；Song et al., 2023；Luo et al., 2023；Lu & Song, 2025；Zheng et al., 2026c；Zheng et al., 2026b），而分布导向的方法则直接对齐学生和教师的输出分布。 DMD 从教师和学生的得分函数中估计反向库尔贝克-莱布勒（KL）梯度，而 DMD2 进一步提升了得分估计和训练稳定性（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a；Ge et al., 2025）。 相关变体进一步将分布匹配适配于高效的少步视频生成（Gu et al., 2026；Ge et al., 2026b）。 对于流式生成，自回归视频模型将视频分解为因果时间块，并通过 KV 缓存复用先前输出。 CausVid（Yin et al., 2025）将双向视频扩散蒸馏为少步因果生成器，而 Self Forcing（Huang et al., 2025a）则通过在学生自身生成的序列上进行训练来缩小训练与推理之间的差距。 Causal Forcing 和 Causal Forcing++ 进一步提升了初始化和可扩展的少步逐帧生成效果（Zhu et al., 2026a；Zhao et al., 2026d），而 Rolling Forcing 和 Self Forcing++ 则将自生成序列训练扩展至长时域生成（Liu et al., 2026；Cui et al., 2026）。 近期研究进一步探索了长时域流式生成的互补机制：Salt++ 对齐了生成器采样与得分估计中的因果上下文，以实现少步多模态生成（Ge et al., 2026a），而 Spatia 则通过维护一个可更新的三维记忆来增强长期空间一致性（Zhao et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial Training for Diffusion Models. Adversarial objectives have been widely used to preserve sample quality under small inference budgets. In image generation, ADD combines diffusion score distillation with a discriminator on frozen DINOv2 features ( Sauer et al., 2024b ) , while related methods also exploit internal diffusion representations ( Sauer et al., 2024a ) . Extending to video generation, APT applies adversarial post-training to one-step synthesis ( Lin et al., 2025a ) , and AAPT further adapts it to autoregressive video generation ( Lin et al., 2025b ) . Subsequent work explores adversarial distribution matching, cross-step self-distillation, phased training, and other autoregressive adversarial formulations ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, most existing methods discriminate with diffusion-internal features, which may provide redundant or conflicting supervision with DMD and remain weakly aligned with decoded videos, limiting sensitivity to pixel-space artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型的对抗训练。 在推理预算有限的情况下，对抗性目标已被广泛用于保持样本质量。 在图像生成中，ADD 将扩散分数蒸馏与基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的判别器相结合（Sauer 等人，2024b），而相关方法也利用了内部扩散表示（Sauer 等人，2024a）。 扩展到视频生成领域，APT 将对抗性后训练应用于单步合成（Lin 等人，2025a），而 AAPT 则进一步将其适配于自回归视频生成（Lin 等人，2025b）。 后续研究探索了对抗性分布匹配、跨步自蒸馏、分阶段训练以及其他自回归对抗性方法（Lu 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2026；Cheng 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026；Feng 等人，2026a；Luo 等人，2026）。 然而，大多数现有方法都使用扩散模型内部特征进行判别，这些特征可能与 DMD 提供的监督存在冗余或冲突，并且与解码后的视频对齐程度较弱，从而限制了对像素空间伪影的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: Pretrained Representations for Generative Modeling. Pretrained representation spaces are increasingly used in generative modeling ( Oquab et al., 2023 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) aligns intermediate DiT states with clean VFM features, while RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026a ) adopts frozen VFM encoders as generative latent spaces. Subsequent works further explore structured representations and representation-space generative supervision ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Feng et al., 2026b ) . In contrast, our proposed method targets an already distilled autoregressive generator and adversarially distinguishes decoded real and generated videos using frozen VFM features, rather than aligning features or redesigning the latent space. This provides real-data supervision complementary to DMD without additional inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 用于生成建模的预训练表示。 预训练表示空间在生成建模中的应用日益广泛（Oquab 等，2023；Siméoni 等，2025；Assran 等，2023；Mur-Labadia 等，2026；Tong 等，2022；Wang 等，2026）。 REPA（Yu 等，2024）将 DiT 的中间状态与干净的 VFM 特征对齐，而 RAE（Zheng 等，2026a）则采用冻结的 VFM 编码器作为生成潜在空间。 后续研究进一步探索了结构化表示和表示空间的生成监督（Shi 等，2026；Wang 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026a；Feng 等，2026b）。 相比之下，我们提出的方法针对一个已经蒸馏完成的自回归生成器，利用冻结的 VFM 特征以对抗性方式区分解码后的真实视频和生成视频，而不是对齐特征或重新设计潜在空间。 这为 DMD 提供了补充的真实数据监督，且不会增加额外的推理成本。

paragraphs.en: In practice, sparse decoding reduces the activation memory for the frozen VAE and VFM. Generated rollouts are decoded without gradients during discriminator updates, while generator updates retain gradients only through latent neighborhoods. Activation checkpointing and stochastic spatial augmentation reduce memory and discourage reliance on fixed local statistics. Since the VAE decoder, VFM, and discriminator heads are training-only, the supervision adds no inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，稀疏解码减少了冻结的 VAE 和 VFM 的激活内存。 在判别器更新期间，生成的 rollout 无需梯度即可解码，而生成器的更新仅通过潜在邻域保留梯度。 激活检查点和随机空间增强可以减少内存使用，并降低对固定局部统计量的依赖。 由于 VAE 解码器、VFM 和判别器头仅在训练阶段使用，因此监督不会增加推理成本。

paragraphs.en: 1-step Frame-wise 5-Second Video Generation. Tab. 1(c) ( 1(b) ) reports VBench and VideoAlign results under the severely constrained one-step-per-frame setting ( 1 † 1^{\dagger} NFE). Radian achieves a VBench Total of 0.8417 0.8417 , a Temporal Style score of 0.7034 0.7034 , and a VideoAlign Total of 0.2563 0.2563 , versus 0.0448 0.0448 for One Forcing, while also outperforming Causal Forcing++ in overall performance and temporal stability. paragraphs.en: 60-Second Long-Video Generation. Tab. 1(c) ( 1(c) ) reports VBench-Long results for 957-frame videos of approximately one minute. Radian also establishes a new state of the art, achieving a VBench-Long Total of 0.8041 0.8041 , a VBench-Long Quality Score of 0.8511 0.8511 , a Dynamic Degree of 0.6741 0.6741 , and an Imaging Quality score of 0.7194 0.7194 . As shown in Fig. 5 and Fig. 8 , our method can better preserve visual details and coherent dynamics over long autoregressive rollouts of 60 seconds, whereas the baseline exhibits accumulated degradation or conservative motion. paragraphs.en: Image Representation Feature Spaces. As shown in Tab. 2 , the three image VFMs induce adversarial gradients with different magnitudes and directions, leading to different optimization strengths under the same objective. DINOv2-S provides a moderate and stable signal, achieving the best overall balance with a VBench Total of 0.8444 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 0.8033 . DINOv3-S produces larger gradients and achieves the highest MQ score of 0.2937 0.2937 , although its aggressive updates are harder to stabilize. SigLIP2 instead provides a more semantics-oriented signal, achieving the highest Overall Consistency score of 0.2680 0.2680 while being less sensitive to fine-grained rendering and motion artifacts. These differences arise from each encoder’s feature scale, token geometry, and input Jacobian; thus, identical discriminator learning rates and adversarial weights do not imply equal supervision strength and require separate calibration.

paragraphs.en: Temporally Structured Video Features. Video VFMs encode cross-frame dependencies and tend to regularize uncertain temporal changes, improving consistency partly by reducing motion amplitude. As shown in Tab. 2 , V-JEPA 2.1 achieves the highest TA score of 0.4119 0.4119 while its Dynamic score drops to 0.5991 0.5991 , reflecting its preference for predictable and temporally persistent content. VideoMAE preserves richer local semantic and appearance cues, reaching a Semantic score of 0.8115 0.8115 and a Color score of 0.8787 0.8787 , but at the cost of an even lower Dynamic score of 0.5213 0.5213 . Combining DINOv2 with VideoMAE provides a better trade-off between artifact-sensitive spatial supervision and complementary temporal regularization, raising the VBench Total to 0.8434 0.8434 , Dynamic to 0.6593 0.6593 , and Multi-Object to 0.8652 0.8652 . These results suggest that video representations are most effective as complementary temporal priors rather than replacements for DINOv2 supervision.

paragraphs.en: Ablation on Encoder Size. We examine whether scaling the frozen DINOv2 encoder improves adversarial distillation. As shown in Tab. 3 , larger encoders do not yield monotonic gains, while DINOv2-S/14 provides the best overall balance in VBench and VideoAlign. DINOv2-G/14 reaches 0.8387 0.8387 and 0.3257 0.3257 , respectively, whereas DINOv2-B/14 achieves a higher VideoAlign Total of 0.8910 0.8910 but a lower VBench Total of 0.8322 0.8322 . This is consistent with ADD, where DINOv2 ViT-S also outperforms ViT-L as the discriminator backbone ( Sauer et al., 2024b ) . Larger ViTs may discard local appearance cues through increasingly invariant semantic features, while higher feature dimensionality and discriminator capacity can yield noisier gradients. Thus, a stronger encoder does not necessarily provide a better adversarial feature space.

paragraphs.en: Ablation on Feature Layer Selection. We further ablate the number and positions of DINOv2 layers used by the discriminator. In Tab. 4 , the one-, two-, four-, and eight-layer settings use blocks { 11 } \{11\} , { 6 , 11 } \{6,11\} , { 6 , 8 , 10 , 11 } \{6,8,10,11\} , and { 2 , 4 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 } \{2,4,6,7,8,9,10,11\} , respectively. paragraphs.en: This paper introduced Radian , a representation adversarial distillation framework for few-step autoregressive video generation. While DMD transfers the diffusion teacher’s generative prior in latent space, Radian complements it with real-data adversarial supervision over multi-level features from a frozen visual foundation model, directly improving decoded video quality without additional inference cost. Experiments across short, one-step, or long-horizon generation demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, motion quality, and autoregressive stability. Our analysis further shows that different representation spaces induce distinct optimization signals: image VFMs differ in gradient strength and emphasize different perceptual or semantic cues, while video-native representations provide temporal regularization, often with reduced motion diversity. Moreover, external VFM gradients are largely complementary to DMD, whereas diffusion-internal adversarial features are more strongly coupled with the original distillation objective. These findings highlight representation-space supervision as an effective way to refine few-step autoregressive video generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 本文介绍了 Radian，一种用于少步自回归视频生成的对抗性表示蒸馏框架。 虽然 DMD 在潜在空间中传递了扩散模型教师的生成先验知识，但 Radian 通过基于冻结视觉基础模型的多级特征的实时数据对抗性监督对其进行了补充，从而直接提升了解码后的视频质量，且无需增加额外的推理成本。 在短步长、单步或长时程生成任务中的实验表明，该方法在视觉保真度、运动质量和自回归稳定性方面均有提升。 我们的分析进一步显示，不同的表示空间会引发不同的优化信号：图像视觉基础模型（VFM）在梯度强度上存在差异，并更强调不同的感知或语义线索；而视频原生表示则提供时间维度上的正则化，但通常会降低运动的多样性。 此外，外部 VFM 的梯度在很大程度上与 DMD 互补，而扩散模型内部的对抗性特征则与原始蒸馏目标耦合得更紧密。 这些发现凸显了基于表示空间的监督是一种有效提升少步自回归视频生成质量的方法。

paragraphs.en: Shared prompts and seeds. All quantitative experiments use the same randomly-chosen 15 inference seeds as the four-step five-second evaluation: 2, 4, 1805718, 3367341, 3718700, 5036436, 5279402, 5450779, 5748298, 7252721, 9274039, 9539461, 5918269, 7730833, and 2436109. This shared set applies to every compared method in the four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and one-minute experiments, as well as all feature-model, encoder-size (including DINOv2-L), and feature-depth ablations. These are inference seeds for fixed model weights, rather than independent training runs. The set was randomly selected from a larger seed pool for further benchmarking. We additionally conducted training runs with different random seeds and observed consistent trends, indicating that the reported improvements are not specific to a particular training seed. In separate internal experiments, we also further applied Radian to a proprietary video generation model and observed consistent improvements, suggesting that the proposed approach extends beyond the Wan2.1-1.3B setting.
paragraphs.zh: 共享提示词和种子。 所有定量实验均使用与四步五秒评估相同的随机选择的 15 个推理种子：2、4、1805718、3367341、3718700、5036436、5279402、5450779、5748298、7252721、9274039、9539461、5918269、7730833 和 2436109。 该共享种子集适用于四步分块实验、单步帧级实验和一分钟实验中所有对比方法，以及所有特征模型、编码器规模（包括 DINOv2-L）和特征深度消融实验。 这些是固定模型权重的推理种子，而非独立的训练运行。 该种子集是从更大的种子池中随机选择的，用于进一步的基准测试。 我们还额外进行了使用不同随机种子的训练运行，并观察到一致的趋势，这表明所报告的性能提升并非特定于某个训练种子。 在独立的内部实验中，我们还进一步将 Radian 应用于一个专有视频生成模型，并观察到一致的性能提升，这表明所提出的方法可以超越 Wan2.1-1.3B 的设置。

paragraphs.en: Long-video metrics. VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) uses its long-video preprocessing and dimension-specific routines, including the configured static-content filter for temporal flickering. It does not score only the first five seconds. Dynamic Degree quantifies detected movement, not necessarily plausible motion; consistency can also increase when movement decreases. We therefore interpret these measures alongside imaging quality and qualitative videos, and report short- and long-video aggregates separately.
paragraphs.zh: 长视频指标。 VBench-Long（Huang 等人，2024）使用其长视频预处理和特定维度的处理程序，包括为应对时间维度上的闪烁而配置的静态内容过滤器。 它并非仅对前五秒进行评分。 动态程度量化的是检测到的运动，而非必然合理的动作；当运动减少时，一致性也可能随之增加。 因此，我们将这些指标与图像质量和定性视频结合解读，并分别报告短视频和长视频的汇总结果。

paragraphs.en: On-policy DMD. The student generates autoregressive rollouts conditioned on its own history. The frozen teacher and trainable fake-score model process the same diffusion-corrupted student latents, and their prediction difference provides the DMD update direction. The update direction is detached when optimizing the student, while the fake-score model is trained separately with a flow-denoising objective on detached student samples. The DMD and representation-adversarial objectives use separate on-policy rollouts sampled from the same student.

paragraphs.en: Batching and hardware. Training follows a five-iteration update cycle: the generator is updated once every five outer iterations, while fake-score and discriminator updates occupy the intervening iterations. The default chunk-wise run uses eight workers, one video per worker, and eight DMD accumulation microbatches, resulting in 64 videos per DMD update. The GAN branch uses one video per worker and eight sampled frames per video, resulting in eight videos per update. Losses are mean-reduced within each branch.
paragraphs.zh: 批量处理与硬件。 训练遵循一个包含五次迭代的更新周期：生成器每五个外层迭代更新一次，而伪分数和判别器的更新则占据其余的迭代次数。 默认的按分块运行方式使用八个工作单元，每个工作单元处理一个视频，并使用八个 DMD 累积微批量，最终每次 DMD 更新处理 64 个视频。 GAN 分支每个工作单元处理一个视频，每个视频使用八个采样帧，因此每次更新处理八个视频。 各分支内的损失值会进行均值归约。

paragraphs.en: Although the encoder parameters are frozen, gradients propagate through its input Jacobian. The adversarial update is therefore shaped by decoded appearance and the encoder’s feature sensitivity, while the DMD update is determined by teacher and fake-score predictions. paragraphs.en: Image-encoder adaptations. DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) uses bilinear resizing and ImageNet normalization; SigLIP2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) uses bicubic resizing and channel mean/standard deviation 0.5. Both use normalized features and a final patch-mean readout in place of the default CLS readout. Selected intermediate features receive affine-free LayerNorm. SigLIP2’s final output retains its pretrained post-normalization, and its 768-channel tokens are projected to 512 channels before discrimination. DINOv3 uses 384-channel heads without the default local normalization. The image feature heads preserve spatial tokens instead of reducing each frame to a single classification embedding. Table 8 summarizes the feature and head designs. Since input geometry and head adaptations vary across model families, these experiments evaluate the resulting representation-supervision configurations as complete design choices.

paragraphs.en: Short-video generation. Figures 6 and 7 compare Radian with Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) and Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) under four-step chunk-wise generation, and with Causal Forcing++ ( Zhao et al., 2026d ) and One Forcing ( Feng et al., 2026a ) under one-step frame-wise generation. In the four-step examples, Radian maintains recognizable faces and keeps the telephone receiver or the pianist’s hands and keyboard visible across the sampled frames. In the one-step examples, the Causal Forcing++ piano sample does not clearly show the requested keyboard interaction, while One Forcing exhibits larger changes in the apparent scale of the campfire and surrounding trees. Radian retains the piano-playing composition and the broader snowy scene. These observations complement the main-text results on the value of decoded-output supervision for preserving visual structure under few-step generation.
paragraphs.zh: 短视频生成。 图 6 和图 7 比较了 Radian 与 Self Forcing（Huang 等，2025a）及 Causal Forcing（Zhu 等，2026a）在四步分块生成中的表现，以及与 Causal Forcing++（Zhao 等，2026d）和 One Forcing（Feng 等，2026a）在单步逐帧生成中的表现。 在四步生成的示例中，Radian 保持了可识别的面部特征，并确保电话听筒或钢琴家的手和键盘在所有采样帧中清晰可见。 在单步生成的示例中，Causal Forcing++ 的钢琴样本未能清晰展示所要求的键盘互动，而 One Forcing 则表现出篝火和周围树木表观尺度上的更大变化。 Radian 保留了弹奏钢琴的构图以及更广阔的场景雪景。 这些观察结果补充了正文中关于解码输出监督在少步生成过程中对视觉结构保持重要性的研究结论。

paragraphs.en: Long-video generation. Figure 8 compares Radian with Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) on four approximately 60-second videos. In the surfing and telephone examples, Rolling Forcing shows larger subject displacements and partial cropping at several sampled times. Radian keeps the panda and surfboard recognizable and retains a clearer view of the person holding the telephone throughout the displayed sequence. The cafe and European-town examples further show changes in viewpoint while preserving identifiable people, objects, and scene context. These examples are consistent with the main-text long-video results, illustrating how the benefits of representation-space supervision can persist beyond the short generation horizon.

paragraphs.en: Discriminator ablations. Figures 9 – 11 visualize the feature-space, encoder-size, and feature-layer configurations studied in our ablations. The feature-space examples reveal distinct appearance preferences: VideoMAE follows the black-and-white instruction more closely in the corgi scene, while DINOv2-S retains some color. The coffee, pastry, and lighthouse cases also show differences in object interaction, surface detail, and framing. In the encoder-size examples, the S configuration makes the liquid color transition more apparent, whereas increasing encoder size does not consistently improve the depicted action. The four-layer configuration also combines recognizable structure with local detail in the corgi and astronaut examples. Together, these visualizations complement the quantitative finding that feature suitability matters more than encoder capacity alone, supporting our compact, multi-level DINOv2-S configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 判别器消融实验。 图 9–11 展示了我们在消融实验中研究的特征空间、编码器尺寸和特征层配置。 特征空间的示例揭示了不同的外观偏好：在柯基场景中，VideoMAE 更严格地遵循了黑白指令，而 DINOv2-S 则保留了一些色彩。 咖啡、糕点和灯塔的案例也显示出物体互动、表面细节和构图方面的差异。 在编码器尺寸的示例中，S 配置使液体颜色的过渡更加明显，而增大编码器尺寸并未始终改善所描绘的动作。 四层配置在柯基和宇航员的示例中也结合了可识别的结构与局部细节。 综合来看，这些可视化结果补充了定量研究结论：特征适用性比单纯的编码器容量更为重要，从而支持了我们紧凑的多层级 DINOv2-S 配置。

paragraphs.en: Cooking in a medieval castle. An adult person prepares vegetables in a wok, holding the handle firmly with one hand while moving a spatula through two compact circular strokes and one small controlled toss. Ingredients remain inside the pan; preserve both hands, wok, stove, vegetables, steam, and heat source. Set the scene inside a historically textured medieval castle with rough stone walls, carved oak furniture, iron fixtures, wool and linen garments, torchlight, banners, and cool daylight from arrow-slit windows. Use a stable period-film composition that keeps the complete action visible; no cuts, whip pans, or sudden costume transformations. Concentrate motion on the requested action and subtle environmental responses while keeping each person’s identity, object topology, and scene layout consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 在中世纪城堡里烹饪。 一位成年人用炒锅准备蔬菜，一只手稳稳握住锅柄，另一只手用铲子完成两次紧凑的圆形翻炒和一次轻柔可控的翻动。 食材仍留在锅内；保留双手、炒锅、炉灶、蔬菜、蒸汽和热源。 将场景设定在一座具有历史质感的中世纪城堡内：粗糙的石墙、雕花的橡木家具、铁制配件、羊毛和亚麻衣物、火把光、旗帜，以及箭窗透进的清冷日光。 采用稳定的时代风格电影构图，确保整个动作清晰可见；不得出现剪辑、快速摇摄或突然的服装变换。 将动作集中在指定的操作及其细微的环境反应上，同时保持每个人物的身份、物体的形态和场景布局的一致性。
